project_name: Twisty Wrap Enterprises - B2B Packaging & Supplies Corporate Site
context: Premium B2B industrial packaging & supplies corporate website for TWISTY WRAP ENTERPRISES. Soft-UI Neumorphism style built on a light neutral-grey base with high-precision industrial editorial layouts, Primary Red accents, and custom 3D interactive hero.

theme.style: Neumorphism (Soft UI) combined with Swiss B2B Industrial Rigor

primary.usage: CTAs, active navigation items, badges, key metrics, accent borders, page numbers

colors.rules: Primary Red is strictly used for high-intent actions, active states, and editorial callouts. Main content surfaces use light grey (#EBF0F5) with dual soft light/dark shadows for the signature neumorphic raised and pressed effects.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

typography.rules: Headings must feature geometric squared sans typography matching the logo brand identity. Never use pure black text (#000000); use deep charcoal #1F2937.

grids_and_layout.hero_layout: Asymmetric 12-column grid. Left 7 cols: Headline, subtext, key bullet pillars, CTA buttons. Right 5 cols: 3D interactive rotating stretch-wrap pallet model canvas.
grids_and_layout.bento_grid: Mode B High-Density / Mode A Tetris grid. Non-uniform cards with neumorphic raised borders and inset hover states.
grids_and_layout.header: Sticky navigation header with soft backdrop blur and neumorphic shadow on scroll (`backdrop-blur-md bg-[#EBF0F5]/90`). NEVER completely transparent background. High contrast desktop links + primary red CTA button.
grids_and_layout.footer: Generous dark slate (#1E2229) neumorphic recessed container with big brand logo, navigation quick links, certifications, sustainability commitments, and newsletter subscription.

component_specifications.neumorphic_button_primary: px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-red-600 text-white font-semibold tracking-wide shadow-[4px_4px_10px_#C1CCD8,-4px_-4px_10px_#FFFFFF] hover:bg-red-700 hover:shadow-inner transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]
component_specifications.neumorphic_button_secondary: px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#EBF0F5] text-slate-800 font-semibold shadow-[6px_6px_14px_#C7D0D9,-6px_-6px_14px_#FFFFFF] hover:shadow-[inset_3px_3px_6px_#C5CFD9,inset_-3px_-3px_6px_#FFFFFF] transition-all duration-200
component_specifications.neumorphic_card: p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl bg-[#EBF0F5] shadow-[8px_8px_18px_#C5CFD9,-8px_-8px_18px_#FFFFFF] border border-white/40 hover:shadow-[12px_12px_24px_#BEC8D4,-12px_-12px_24px_#FFFFFF] transition-all duration-300
component_specifications.neumorphic_input: w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#EBF0F5] text-slate-800 shadow-[inset_3px_3px_6px_#C5CFD9,inset_-3px_-3px_6px_#FFFFFF] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500/50 transition-all

badges.recyclable: bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm inline-flex items-center gap-1
badges.customizable: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm inline-flex items-center gap-1

3d_and_motion.three_js_hero: Real-time 3D Canvas built with `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei`. Features a slowly spinning industrial stretch-wrapped pallet with stacked boxes. Interactive mouse parallax rotation with ambient lighting and soft drop shadows.
3d_and_motion.lenis_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled globally using `@studio-freight/lenis` or `lenis`.
3d_and_motion.framer_motion: Page section reveals with staggered fade-in + slide up (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`). Headline text line-by-line reveal animation.
3d_and_motion.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon text ticker featuring 'PROTECT. PACKAGE. PERFORM. SUSTAIN.' with low contrast grey/red styling.

catalogue_and_pdf.preview_mode: Interactive online flip-through modal/view with page turn navigation, thumbnail sidebar, and search inside catalogue.
catalogue_and_pdf.cover_page: Glassmorphism brand header overlay with Twisty Wrap Enterprises red shield logo and geometric title styling.
catalogue_and_pdf.inner_pages: Flat professional grid with top-right corner company logo, page numbers in Primary Red, product technical specs, and application tables.
catalogue_and_pdf.download_pdf: Direct downloadable PDF catalogue trigger button with modal lead capture form.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files in src/components and src/pages.
Ensure the neumorphic system is implemented cleanly using Tailwind CSS utility classes and custom shadow definitions in tailwind.config.js.
Include mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid="enquiry-submit-button", data-testid="download-catalogue-btn").
Never create completely transparent headers or dropdown backgrounds; use solid or high-opacity backdrop blurs.
Ensure all 3D canvas components are lazy-loaded with a elegant fallback skeleton loader.
Provide full functionality for Catalogue Flip-Through Preview, PDF Download, Enquiry Modal, Product Category Filters, and Search.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and full-screen heavy gradients. Use 2-3x generous spacing. Add subtle hover states, smooth scroll, and micro-interactions on every button and card. Ensure contrast compliance (WCAG AA). All interactive components MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
